export_scope: Two byte-identical repeat Web exports from one clean guarded import. Browser validation is a separate required release gate.
scope: Tested incremental menu, contextual touch, mobile Stop and terrain beta; not full-game acceptance.
features: Traditional Chinese opening menu, Help, start, pause-preserving return and resume; Help navigation stays outside scrollable prose.
Selected units accept contextual destination or target taps; villagers expose build actions immediately.
Compact Stop remains visible without horizontally scrolling the action strip.
Connected dirt paths, stone settlement courtyard and varied grass/earth terrain.

native_validation.scope: Headless controlled value, command and UI fixtures. Synthetic handlers and end states are not natural play, rendering, device or victory acceptance.

browser_validation.input: Chrome emulated touchscreen, not a physical phone

scenarios.passed: Help and Back, Start, full visible Stop/build targets, Command/Cancel, retained paused match, cancel New Match, Resume; no observed unintended movement/economy effects across bounded tick checks.
Ordinary Start, visible worker build controls, actual house placement/debit, Stop, unchanged unfinished progress across 20 simulation ticks, ordinary reassignment and resumed work.

Ordinary Start, selection, direct ground tap followed by measured movement toward the destination, then direct visible-resource tap followed by actual cargo gain. Destination arrival and combat were not tested.

browser_validation.screenshots: Actual final-build screenshots inspected: 320px Help Back fully visible; Stop and house action readable; 390px no-builder guidance readable and house progress increases after resume; stone courtyard and connected terrain visibly changed. No matched historical camera baseline is claimed.
browser_validation.network_gate: Zero observed browser errors including context close. Exact pinned WASM/PCK GETs returned 200 and finished.
browser_validation.fixture_cache_policy: Only the two pinned public streams use no-cache in a fresh isolated fixture context; other responses retain no-store. Public Pages uses its own static caching policy. Earlier failed runs remain failed.

validation_limits: Physical iPhone/Android, landscape browser pixels, audible audio, physical multi-touch ergonomics, OS interruptions and browser-history behavior remain unverified.

A bounded full-match attempt on earlier candidate vc-e721ebcc3237 achieved economy, house/barracks/range construction, spear/archer production and AI combat, but stopped without victory. This is not a full-match pass on this release.
No full rendered growth-to-victory sequence or current-build natural browser combat was validated.
Weapon, tool and shield grip/animation corrections are not included in this release.
Browser tests used exact exported bytes on a hosted loopback server. Actual public served-byte verification follows deployment.
